payload.title: PaMoDaCo: Working with measurements and model output
payload.description: This notebook integrates sparse measurement data with model outputs to assess the accuracy of model simulations of neodymium isotopes. It utilizes data from Poppelmeier et al., 2021, and the C-iTRACE simulation to analyze spatial distributions of $\varepsilon$Nd. The notebook demonstrates loading and processing of datasets, plotting spatial distributions, and examining the uniqueness of measured values in the water column.

steps.description: Import necessary libraries for data processing and visualization.
steps.title: Imports

steps.description: Load and process neodymium isotopes data from the C-iTRACE model, calculate $\varepsilon$Nd, and select a time slice for analysis.
steps.title: Load C-iTRACE Model Output

steps.description: Load and preprocess the dataset from Poppelemeier et al., 2021, which includes LGM and Holocene $\varepsilon$Nd values.
steps.title: Load Poppelemeier et al., 2021 Dataset

steps.description: Create a surface plot with scatter overlay using the processed model and measurement data, focusing on a depth of 2000m.
steps.title: Surface with Scatter Plot

steps.description: Select a depth transect and add empirical data to visualize the distribution along a section.
steps.title: Section with Scatter Plot

steps.description: Analyze the uniqueness of $\varepsilon$Nd measurements by examining the range of depths at a given location that fall within a specified uncertainty window.
steps.title: Uniqueness Analysis
